subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “It introduced timed entry and guided routes to spread people out.”?
options: Students were disturbed because the mouth and voice looked real.
In class, students discussed whether floating farms were a good idea.
Students discussed how social media can change real places quickly.
In media class, students discussed the event.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students were disturbed because the mouth and voice looked real.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In class, students discussed whether floating farms were a good idea.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It introduced timed entry and guided routes to spread people out. Students discussed how social media can change real places quickly.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「In media class, students discussed the event.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It introduced timed entry and guided routes to spread people out. Students discussed how social media can change real places quickly.」，答案為「Students discussed how social media can change real places quickly.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students discussed how social media can change real places quickly.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
